Name: Ethan, Son of Kushaiah
Summary: Merarite singer, son of Kushaiah, appointed to sound with cymbals of brass.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 15:17; 1 Chronicles 15:19: Merarite singer, son of Kushaiah, appointed to sound with cymbals of brass.
LifeLesson: The mention of Ethan in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
